args.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION prevent_critical_equipment_delete()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "Equipment" e
        JOIN "EquipmentType" et ON e."EquipType" = et."EquipType"
        WHERE e."EQUIP_CODE" = OLD."EQUIP_CODE"
          AND e."EquipType" = 'Safety'
          AND CAST(et."type_indices"->>'safety_idx' AS numeric) > 0.75
          AND (
              EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 
                  FROM "LightingAndSafety" ls
                  WHERE ls."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
                    AND (ls."lifeSupportStat" IS NOT NULL OR ls."O2SupplyStat" IS NOT NULL)
              )
              OR
              EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM "Communication" comm
                  JOIN "WeatherAndStructure" ws ON ws."loc_link" = comm."loc_link"
                  WHERE comm."equipRef" = e."EQUIP_CODE"
                    AND ws."extTempC" < 0
              )
          )
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot delete critical equipment: % - This is a safety-critical asset', OLD."EQUIP_CODE";
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER protect_critical_equipment
BEFORE DELETE ON "Equipment"
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_critical_equipment_delete();
